Beautifully Designed Residences

Experience the essence of luxurious coastal living at Celestia Homes, an exclusive residential community designed to harmonize with the natural beauty of the Mediterranean. With just 25 one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, this boutique-style development offers privacy, sophistication, and a serene lifestyle. Situated to maximise breathtaking sea views and sunlight, Celestia Homes is the perfect haven for those seeking comfort, elegance, and modern convenience.

Imagine waking up to panoramic sea views, enjoying sunny afternoons on your private terrace, and relaxing in the serene surroundings of a gated community. This two-bedroom apartment at Celestia Homes offers an exceptional opportunity to embrace coastal living in style and comfort.

Contact us today to learn more about this stunning home or schedule a private tour. Let Celestia Homes be your gateway to the lifestyle you’ve always dreamed of on the Costa del Sol.
